message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "quantitative_trajectory_assessment", "description": "When evaluating disease progression or resolution between two timepoints, use objective classifier scores rather than relying solely on visual inspection or textual reports.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks requiring comparison of medical imaging findings across multiple timepoints to determine clinical trajectory (resolution, persistence, or progression).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "When assessing disease trajectory between an initial and follow-up image: (1) invoke `chest_xray_classifier` on the initial image to obtain a baseline severity score; (2) invoke `chest_xray_classifier` on the follow-up image to obtain the current severity score; (3) compare the quantitative outputs to determine if findings have resolved (score drop to non-strong) or persisted, rather than relying solely on visual inspection or textual reports."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
